title: Hermes no_agent Cron Mode
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 no_agent cron mode configuration. Every cron run must have a logged decision point and subject scope must be enforced.

mode.description: no_agent cron mode value. When set, agent session is not created.

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the cron configuration.

decision_log_enabled.description: Whether decision logging is enabled for this cron.

last_decision_point.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last decision point.

last_run_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last cron run.
